about.heading: Investing in Your Health, Investing in Your Future
about.text: At Dashvanth Healthcare, we go beyond treating illnesses — we deliver complete, compassionate, multispeciality care to every patient. Located in Krishna Nagar Extension, East Delhi, our centre brings hospital-quality expertise right to your neighbourhood.
